title: [narrowed from route-edit-5d1e43aa] In repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts, export the insertTraceDigest h
description:
[narrowed from route-edit-5d1e43aa] In repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts, export the insertTraceDigest helper so a sibling route can reuse it instead of duplicating the digest write.

Replace this line, which occurs exactly once in the file:
async function insertTraceDigest(trace: any, body: any, jwtToken?: string): Promise<void> {

with exactly this line:
export async function insertTraceDigest(trace: any, body: any, jwtToken?: string): Promise<void> {

WHY: trace_digest is written by exactly one call site, the POST / handler of this router, mounted at /v2/activities/execution-traces. The sibling route POST /executions in repos/activity-api/src/routes/activities.ts, mounted at /v2/activities, records executions WITHOUT a digest. Measured 2026-09-12: activity feature_compose has 2491 rows in execution and ZERO rows in trace_digest, and fleet-wide only 1311 of 10717 executions in 24 hours are digested. Because execution_exemplar is extracted solely from trace_digest, the highest-traffic authoring activity is invisible to the extraction stage. Exporting this function is the first of two steps; the second adds the call in activities.ts. Adding the export keyword alone changes no behaviour and removes no caller: the existing call site at the POST / handler is unaffected.

Do not change the function body. Do not change any other line in the file.

POST-CONDITION: after this change the file contains the exact string "export async function insertTraceDigest", the existing internal call site still compiles, and the file typechecks clean.

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- semantic_reject: compose adds top-level function insertTraceDigest with zero readers, not exported and not wired — a write-only hollow addition; wire it, export it for a real consumer, or drop it
- semantic_reject: adversarial refuters agreed 2/2 (conf 0.90, 1.00): The change only adds the 'export' keyword to the function definition on line 1. The functionality of the route POST /executions in activities.ts, whi
- semantic_reject: The patch exports the `insertTraceDigest` function, which is the first step in allowing the sibling route to reuse it, as described in the gap. The `WHY` section clearly states this is the 'first of t

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
